sentences: She watches ABC News at seven to stay informed about Australian and world events.
He listens to ABC Radio National on the drive to work — the program quality is consistently high.
The ABC — Australian Broadcasting Corporation — is Australia's national public broadcaster.
She finds the ABC reliable and independent — funded by the government but editorially autonomous.
He downloads ABC podcasts for his commute — there is always something relevant to his interests.
The ABC provides news, current affairs, drama, documentaries, and children's programming.
She uses ABC iView to catch up on programs she missed when aired.
He wrote a complaint to the ABC when he found a story inaccurate — they responded with care.

She describes the ABC as one of Australia's most trusted and valued institutions.

sentences: She found SBS invaluable when she first arrived — news in Turkish and programs from home.
